test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
What is the best meaning of "**compound**" in the sentence:

"Changes that seem small and unimportant at first will compound into remarkable results if you're willing to stick with them for years."

options.text: To accumulate and grow over time

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3** i.e. **To accumulate and grow over time**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the passage, the word "**compound**" is used metaphorically to indicate that small changes, when repeated consistently over time, accumulate and lead to significant results.
 
• The idea is similar to money compounding with interest—small, consistent contributions grow exponentially over time.
 
• "To accumulate and grow over time" best captures this meaning.
 
• Other options like "to decrease gradually," "to mix different elements," or "to remain constant" do not fit the context of cumulative growth described in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: To decrease gradually** (धीरे-धीरे कम होना) – Incorrect; the passage discusses growth, not reduction.
 
• **Option 2: To mix different elements** (विभिन्न तत्वों को मिलाना) – Incorrect; the passage refers to accumulation over time, not mixing.
 
• **Option 4: To remain constant** (स्थिर रहना) – Incorrect; the context implies change and growth, not staying the same.
